text:
maya: FYI CI canary image push red on PR #6124 after my Dockerfile change (COPY --chown + touch). Build failed during push with 'unexpected EOF' from registry, rerun sometimes passes.

dev-buildbot: build 1745553328 failed: step=push status=failed code=EPIPE message="unexpected EOF while writing blob" logs: https://ci.redwood/1745553328/logs (auto)

sam: can you paste the exact build command/args and base image?

maya: `docker buildx build --platform=linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t registry.redwood/dev/canary:pr6124 --push .` Base: `python:3.11-slim`. I added `COPY --chown=1000:1000 . /app` and `RUN find . -exec touch -t 202001010000 {} +` to normalize mtimes.

leo: hmm. buildx + multi-arch + tar mtime normalization can change layer hashes. Registry might struggle if a blob upload is truncated. Any 401s in the push logs?

dev-buildbot: registry responded 401 once then 200 for same chunk. excerpt: "PATCH /v2/.../blobs/uploads/... 401 Unauthorized" then "PUT ...?digest=sha256:... 200 OK" — intermittent auth during upload.

ops-bot: fyi we rotated the registry upload token yesterday at 03:00 UTC; there is a 15m overlap window. could be proxy cached creds hitting an older token. which runner handled the job?

maya: runner=ci-runner-7 (eu-west). I retried twice: first rerun passed, second rerun failed again.

sam: try forcing `--no-cache` and reproduce locally with `buildx build --load` (no push) to validate layer formation. also check .dockerignore — large context can make chunked uploads flaky.

maya: starting a local reproduce now. will report.

(10m later)

maya: local --load succeeds. pushing from same machine fails with EOF. suspect network/proxy auth interplay. also realized `.dockerignore` didn't exclude node_modules so context was ~500MB — could be timing out on chunked upload.

leo: can you try `skopeo copy docker-daemon:registry.redwood/dev/canary:pr6124 docker://registry.redwood/dev/repro:tmp` to isolate push path, and `skopeo inspect --raw docker://...` to examine layers if accessible?

maya: skopeo errors with `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` on my laptop — runner has CA bundle, mine doesn't. odd.

sam: immediate unblock options: 1) rerun CI with `--no-cache` and bump push retries to 5 in pipeline; 2) revert the touch change in Dockerfile and see if push stabilizes; which do you want to try first?

maya: I'll open a PR to revert the touch and rerun. also asking infra to check registry token refresh and nginx proxy logs for ci-runner-7 timeframe.

ops-bot: created ticket INF-2319 (registry/upload flake) and assigned to @leo. ETA ~1h. :spiral_calendar:

leo: grabbing proxy logs now. note — buildkit can reuse blobs but if metadata differs (mtimes, uname/gid ordering) the tar stream can change; some registries dedupe by digest and expect consistent chunking. I'll grep nginx logs for 1745553300-1745553700.

sam: tagging @devops for runner CA issue (skopeo x509). @alex can you help with runner image CA bundle?

alex: on it, will sync with runners team; likely missing corporate CA after base image refresh.

maya: thanks all. I'll revert the touch tweak and push a canary. if it still flakes i'll paste the full CI job URL and logs here. :thumbsup:
